text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim in the opening and closing","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"The essay states a position early and returns to it at the end, keeping the writing centered on a defendable claim."},{"evidence":"multiple paragraphs weighing positives and negatives","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged into distinct sections that develop the argument in a more orderly way."},{"evidence":"“gas consumption... cut greatly” and “less polluting emissions”","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay draws on specific article ideas to support its reasons instead of relying mostly on general assertions."},{"evidence":"“what if there's an accident, who's to blame?” and law discussion","quality":"reasoned analysis","description":"The essay explains why the legal and liability issues matter rather than just mentioning them."},{"evidence":"“Despite there being zero reported accidents” then addresses concerns","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges objections and then tries to answer them, which makes the argument more balanced."}]}
